defs.title: How these are counted
defs.collected: <term>Collected</term> — payments taken online or recorded in person, minus refunds, on the day they were paid. Before Kept and card fees.
defs.bookings: <term>Bookings</term> — appointments taking place in the period (including later today), excluding cancellations and expired holds.
defs.ticket: <term>Average ticket & earned</term> — value of completed visits after discounts, before tax.
defs.rates: <term>Completion & no-show rate</term> — share of appointments that have already ended.
defs.returning: <term>Returning clients</term> — had a completed visit with you before this period.

promote.description: Get in front of more people searching on Kept, and give clients a reason to book.
promote.spotlightBody: Your profile leads the results when people nearby search for what you offer.

where.title: Where you appear
where.body: At the top of the first page of search and category results you already match — location and filters still apply. At most {max} promoted profiles per search.

labelled.title: Always labelled
labelled.body: Customers see “Promoted” next to your name, along with your real rating and openings.

rotation.title: Fair rotation
rotation.body: When more businesses are promoted than there are spots, they’re picked in random order on each search so everyone gets a fair share.

cost.title: Cost
cost.body: Free while Kept is launching. If that changes we’ll tell you before anything is charged — it never switches to paid on its own.

spotlight.impressionHint: An impression is counted each time you’re shown as a promoted result; a visit when someone opens your profile from it.
spotlight.startBody: Runs from now for the length you pick. You can pause or end it any time.
spotlight.endBody: Your profile stops appearing as a promoted result right away. Its numbers stay in your history, and you can start a new campaign whenever you like.
